content:
SZCH (pronounced [ʃt͡ɕ]) is a DJ and producer from Istria, now based in Zagreb, Croatia. His sets draw from club music, UK sounds, leftfield electronics and rap, moving freely between new and overlooked records while favouring unexpected connections over strict genre boundaries.

He has performed across Europe and his mixes have appeared on NTS, Balamii, Red Light Radio, Operator, Berlin Community Radio, AAJA Deptford and LYL. Alongside DJing, he previously co-founded the Low Income Squad label and collective before launching Value, a Zagreb-based platform for club nights, exhibitions and live events.

SZCH (pronounced [ʃt͡ɕ]) is a DJ and producer from Istria, now based in Zagreb, Croatia. His sets draw from club music, UK sounds, leftfield electronics and rap, moving freely between new and overlooked records while favouring unexpected connections over strict genre boundaries.

He has performed across Europe, including Germany, France, Ukraine, the Netherlands, Switzerland, the UK and Poland, and his mixes have appeared on NTS, Balamii, AAJA Deptford, Red Light Radio, Operator, Berlin Community Radio and LYL.

Alongside DJing, he previously co-founded the Low Income Squad label and collective before launching Value, a Zagreb-based platform connecting music, art and photography through club nights, exhibitions and live events.

SZCH (izgovara se [ʃt͡ɕ]) je DJ i producent iz Istre, danas u Zagrebu. U svojim se setovima kreće između klupske glazbe, UK zvuka, leftfield elektronike i rapa, spajajući nova i zanemarena izdanja bez prevelikog obaziranja na žanrovske granice.

Nastupao je diljem Europe, a njegovi su se mixevi mogli čuti na NTS-u, Balamii, Red Light Radiu, Operatoru, Berlin Community Radiu, AAJA Deptfordu i LYL-u. Ranije je suosnovao kolektiv i etiketu Low Income Squad, te pokrenuo Value, zagrebačku platformu za klupske večeri, izložbe i nastupe uživo.

Nastupao je diljem Europe, uključujući Njemačku, Francusku, Ukrajinu, Nizozemsku, Švicarsku, Ujedinjeno Kraljevstvo i Poljsku, a njegovi su se mixevi mogli čuti na NTS-u, Balamii, AAJA Deptfordu, Red Light Radiu, Operatoru, Berlin Community Radiu i LYL-u.

Ranije je suosnovao kolektiv i etiketu Low Income Squad, nakon čega je pokrenuo Value, zagrebačku platformu koja kroz klupske večeri, izložbe i nastupe uživo povezuje glazbu, umjetnost i fotografiju.
